verses.text: On that day seven women will grab hold of one man and say, "We will eat our own food and wear our own clothes. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our shame!"
On that day, the branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of those left alive in Israel.
Whoever is left in Zion and whoever remains in Jerusalem will be called holy, everyone in Jerusalem whose name is written among the living.
This will happen when the Lord has washed away the filth of the women of Zion, and cleaned the blood from Jerusalem, by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of fire.
Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over those who gather there a cloud of smoke by day and a glow of flaming fire by night. Over all the glory there will be a covering.
It will be a shelter that gives shade from the heat of the day, and a safe place and hiding place from the storm and the rain.
